originality.rationale: Primary full-text comparison with Miller's exact semiprime singularity law explicitly removes aggregate singularity and its fixed-weight implication from the new claim. What remains is the six-way rank-and-geometry partition and the rank-by-weight multiplicities, not obtained from a determinant-zero count without additional Fourier-orbit and 0/1 matrix-rigidity steps. Yang’s general rank identity and weight-wise invertibility theorem are also credited; older cyclotomic structure is credited; unresolved possibility of an unindexed rank table is noted.
residual_risks: The 1956 Ingleton paper could contain a structurally equivalent rank classification; its full text was inaccessible.
An unindexed enumeration or rank table might precede this refinement.

Much of the cyclotomic infrastructure and the entire aggregate singularity law were already known; novelty is limited strictly to rank-refined distribution and its geometric necessary-and-sufficient conditions.
